settings.name: USE_ANTIDDOS
settings.description: Enable or disable anti DDoS protection to mitigate high traffic spikes.

settings.name: ANTIDDOS_METRICS_DICT_SIZE
settings.description: Size of in-memory storage for DDoS metrics (e.g., 10M, 500k).

settings.name: ANTIDDOS_THRESHOLD
settings.description: Maximum suspicious requests allowed from a single IP before blocking.

settings.name: ANTIDDOS_WINDOW_TIME
settings.description: Time window (seconds) to detect abnormal request patterns.

settings.name: ANTIDDOS_STATUS_CODES
settings.description: HTTP status codes treated as suspicious for DDoS analysis.

settings.name: ANTIDDOS_TLS
settings.description: Count TLS handshakes and stop TLS floods. USE_ANTIDDOS must also be yes. Start with SECURITY_MODE=detect. Cores before 1.6.18~rc3 protect only handshakes without SNI, with MULTISITE=yes or DISABLE_DEFAULT_SERVER=yes; single-site has no TLS protection. 1.6.18~rc3 or later also protects every named service.

settings.name: ANTIDDOS_TLS_WINDOW_TIME
settings.description: TLS counting window in seconds (5 to 999). Idle handshakes are checked after the window ends, with five extra seconds for a first request.

settings.name: ANTIDDOS_TLS_IDLE_THRESHOLD
settings.description: Minimum handshakes without a first request in one fixed window before flagging an address. This rule needs no distinct-IP minimum.

settings.name: ANTIDDOS_TLS_IDLE_RATIO
settings.description: Minimum percentage of handshakes without a first request (50 to 100). The idle handshake threshold must also be reached.

settings.name: ANTIDDOS_TLS_HELLO_THRESHOLD
settings.description: TLS handshakes per address in a sliding window before flagging it. ANTIDDOS_DISTINCT_IP must also be reached. Set 0 to disable this volume rule.

settings.name: ANTIDDOS_TLS_IPV6_PREFIX
settings.description: Group IPv6 addresses by this prefix length for TLS counting and local flags. IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses count as IPv4.

settings.name: ANTIDDOS_TLS_BAN_TIME
settings.description: How long a TLS flag or supported core ban lasts, in seconds (10 to 86400). Existing operator bans are never replaced.

settings.name: ANTIDDOS_TLS_IGNORE_IP
settings.description: Space-separated IP addresses and CIDRs excluded from TLS counting and drops. On core 1.6.15, add monitoring addresses here because its core whitelist is unavailable at ClientHello.

settings.name: ANTIDDOS_TLS_DICT_SIZE
settings.description: Memory for TLS counters, candidate lists and local flags (for example 10M or 500k). Full storage fails open, so increase this for large address populations.

settings.name: ANTIDDOS_DISTINCT_IP
settings.description: Minimum distinct IP count before enabling anti DDoS measures.
